description: This file contains a shell script function `normalize_pr_changelog_entries` that processes a CHANGELOG.md file, and a Node.js script embedded within the shell script to update changelog entries based on pull request numbers. It manages changelog sections, ensures entries are correctly placed, and includes validation functions to enforce consistency.

methods.name: normalize_pr_changelog_entries
methods.description: Normalizes changelog entries related to a specific PR by moving entries into the correct section and subsection titled 'Unreleased' and 'Changes', ensuring proper placement, and preventing duplicates.

methods.name: validate_changelog_entry_for_pr
methods.description: Validates that the changelog entries for a specific PR are correctly added, positioned at the end of the relevant section, and include necessary references and acknowledgments.

methods.name: validate_changelog_merge_hygiene
methods.description: Ensures that during a merge, no PR references are lost, particularly checking for dropped entries related to PR references.
